definitions.explanation: A flowering plant famous for its beautiful, fragrant blooms and thorny stems. Roses symbolize love and beauty.

examples.english: Roses are blooming in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{薔薇|ばら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a bouquet of red roses.

examples.japanese: {薔薇|ばら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The scent of roses is wonderful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薔薇|ばら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鉢植|はちう}え→鉢植え：15062_hachiue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼントした→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧。
examples.english: I gave a potted rose as a gift on Mother's Day.

notes:
{薔薇|ばら} refers to roses.

Alternative writing: バラ (katakana, very common)

Common expressions:
- {薔薇|ばら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧ (bouquet of roses)
- {薔薇|ばら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (scent of roses)
- {薔薇|ばら}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (rose-colored; rosy)
- {薔薇|ばら}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧ (rosy life; life of happiness)
- {薔薇|ばら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{棘|とげ}→棘：13134_toge⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (roses have thorns - beauty comes with difficulties)

Counter: ⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ (for stems)

Note:
The kanji {薔薇|ばら} is notoriously difficult to write, so バラ is commonly used. Roses are associated with Western culture but are very popular in Japan. Rose gardens can be found throughout the country, and roses are common gifts for romantic occasions.
